classifications.cause: New native build fixture lacked TEMP/TMP after environment sanitization; MSBuild tried Windows temp and access failed. All 46 tests failed in build setup, no host test body ran.
classifications.repair: Only new fixture adds external private TEMP/TMP.

classifications.cause: New fixture also lacked HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA; NuGet tooling could not derive path1. All 46 errors were setup.
classifications.repair: Only new fixture adds process-local private profiles; empty external feed; no product/global config changes.

classifications.cause: One new test assumed SDDL generic-access text GA survived object-specific conversion. Windows effective pipe security maps it to full FILE_ALL_ACCESS; protected DACL and PID gate were correct.
classifications.repair: New oracle now verifies binary DACL protection, exactly 2 ACEs, NETWORK deny SID and TokenUser allow SID with full effective mask. No native product/security change; no weakened assertion.

classifications.cause: Base Python user-site environment does not supply pypdf/numpy and child private profile cannot find pytest. Core phase0 Knowledge event, Security child crash-reopen, Knowledge collection (21 errors), MEMORY 5 traces affected.
classifications.repair: Reused already installed historical Python 3.14.6 virtualenv with pytest 9.1.1/pypdf 6.19.0/numpy 2.5.3; same CI inventory and unchanged product/tests/runner. No dependency install, retry for quality or test filter.

classifications.cause: Private HOME differs from USERPROFILE; PowerShell automatic $HOME follows USERPROFILE. Same assertion fails before and after this block.
